subject: general
question: How many athletes received the Arjuna Award, 2024, during the January 2025 ceremony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**32**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Awards 2024** were presented by the **President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu**, at the **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in **New Delhi** on **17 January 2025**.
 
• A total of **32 athletes** were conferred with the **Arjuna Award 2024** for their outstanding performance in national and international sports events.
 
• The award recognizes athletes for their **consistent excellence, leadership qualities, sportsmanship, and discipline** over a period of four years.
 
• The recipients represented a wide range of sports, including **athletics, hockey, badminton, shooting, wrestling, para-sports, chess, and kabaddi**.
 
• The Arjuna Award is one of India's highest sporting honours administered by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 32.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• Instituted in **1961** by the Government of India.
 
• Given for outstanding achievement in sports and games.
 
 
 
• **Award Components:**
 
 
• A **bronze statuette of Arjuna**.
 
• A **certificate**, **ceremonial dress**, and a **cash prize**.
 
 
 
• **Major National Sports Awards:**
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** – India's highest sporting honour.
 
• **Dronacharya Award** – For outstanding coaches.
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Award** – For lifetime achievement in sports.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process:**
 
 
• The awardees are selected by a committee constituted by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• International achievements and consistency of performance are key criteria.
 
 
 
• **Purpose:**
 
 
• To encourage athletes and promote excellence in sports across India.
